title: A remote erase landing while the Settings sheet is up may leave firstRun set with no onboarding cover shown
evidence: RootView.recordChanged sets firstRun when erasedElsewhere, but the full-screen onboarding cover belongs to TabView, and SwiftUI may not present it while a child sheet (Settings) is up; firstRun then stays set with nothing on screen, blocking recordChanged and offerCloud until relaunch (onboarded is false, so a relaunch heals it). Predates PR 1284; PR 1284's holdLifts recheck adds one more moment it can happen (a local erase ending refused while a remote erase landed). Rare, not seen on a device. Remedy if wanted: when a remote erase lands with Settings up, wait for the sheet to close before restarting. Found by the PR 1284 re-check (adversary R2), RootView.swift ~:117, DataEraser.swift ~:111.
